properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-OAEP decryption is the library's preferred RSA decrypt path (CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP, rsa.go:534) with caller-chosen hash, separate MGF1 hash and label. Tests cover SHA-1/224/256/384/512 with and without labels. First-party, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: this is the library's own shipped API. The CBC capability can stay (some tokens only support CBC), but callers should be steered to NewGCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library's shipped RSA API surface plus its test suite. crypto11 wraps PKCS#11 HSMs: rsa.go:140 generates RSA keypairs (CKM_RSA_PKCS_KEY_PAIR_GEN), rsa.go:204-279 implement FindRSAPrivateKey(s)WithAttributes/makeRSAPrivateKey (the exported find-and-load API), and rsa_test.go/keys_test.go/certificates_test.go exercise that surface against a token. Changeable here: yes — first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: the library chooses what it registers; dropping SHA-1 would be a semver-breaking API change for existing tokens.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's raw PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA decryption path (CKM_RSA_PKCS). It knowingly exposes the Bleichenbacher-oracle class: rsa.go:476-487 documents the risk, collapses token error reasons to rsa.ErrDecryption to shrink the oracle, and rejects SessionKeyLen != 0 (the stdlib countermeasure cannot be implemented over an HSM). Recorded as the sound-pad alternative's weaker sibling; first-party and changeable here (deprecate/limit the path).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-PSS signing support in the library's crypto.Signer implementation for HSM keys. Sign with *rsa.PSSOptions dispatches to signPSS; salt length resolved like crypto/rsa (maxPSSSaltLength). Shipped first-party code + interop tests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The one math/rand use in the repo: crypto11_test.go:149 `randomSlot := int(rand.Uint32())` picks a bogus slot number for TestSelectByNonExistingSlot, which asserts the token-not-found error. No key or IV material derives from it — keygen randomness is crypto/rand (ALG-80605930). Benign test infrastructure, but the import and use are real, so it stays recorded with its purpose; the object's 'in a security context' claim does not hold at this site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) is one of the three curves in the library's supported-curve registry (ecdsa.go:73) behind GenerateECDSAKeyPair/WithAttributes, which drive CKM_ECDSA_KEY_PAIR_GEN and CKM_ECDSA on the token. Tests exercise keygen, signing and certificate building on P-256. First-party.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384 (secp384r1) and P-521 (secp521r1) complete the library's ECDSA curve registry (ecdsa.go:75-81) — meets CNSA interim strength but classical, broken by Shor. keygen_test.go:69/79 verify EC-parameter marshalling and round-trip for P-384. First-party.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here (first-party feature). Already post-quantum — this IS the migration target for the library's classical key-transport paths. Parameter sets 512/768/1024 are all selectable by the caller.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: cSHAKE128/256 are the SHA-3-family XOFs under the library's KMAC-based ML-KEM KDF (mlkem_kdf.go:72 KMAC128, :79 KMAC256) — the FIPS 203 encapsulation/decapsulation key derivation. rsa_test.go:312 signs a SHA3-256 digest via the HSM key. Same call sites are read by the SHAKE object (ALG-6d9e0af5) and KMAC object (ALG-b870901e) — three primitives over one chain, all legitimate CBOM entries. First-party.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: cSHAKE128/cSHAKE256 are NIST SP 800-185 customizable SHAKE XOFs — the extendable-output function under the library's KMAC ML-KEM KDF. Same lines as the SHA-3 (ALG-052c24b2) and KMAC (ALG-b870901e) objects: one call chain, three primitive readings (XOF here). First-party.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here, first-party implementation over the Go stdlib. Part of the PQ path, not a liability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 key generation exercised on the token through the library's GenerateSecretKey path (CipherAES, CKM_AES / CKM_AES_KEY_GEN). Quantum-resistant under Grover but below the CNSA 2.0 AES-256 preference — a parameter-set posture item, not a break. First-party test driving first-party API.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand is the test suite's randomness source: randomBytes() (common_test.go:28-30) generates key IDs, IVs (common_test.go:39) and key material feeds, all passed as rand.Reader to stdlib keygen. This is the secure choice — recorded as the good half of the RNG posture (the weak half, math/rand in crypto11_test.go, is object ALG-7d1fdc12).
